notices.agenda_text:
EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY COUNCIL
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS


The Eagle Mountain City Council will hold public hearings on October 6, 2026, at 7:00 PM or as soon thereafter as business allows, in the Eagle Mountain City Council Chambers, 1650 E Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, Utah 84005.  The City Council will receive public comments concerning the following items:

Corrigan Farms RTI Rezone: 

-	Corrigan Farms RTI Rezone: Corrigan Farms LLC requests parcel number 59:068:0006 be rezoned to the RTI overlay zone to potentially develop a data center project with a natural gas powerplant. 
EMC Point of Contact: Senior Planner, David Stroud dstroud@eaglemountain.gov.  

Impact Fee Facilities Plan (IFFP):

-	Culinary Water IFFP: Consideration of an update to the Culinary Water IFFP. This update adds the Spring Run/Talons Cove area to the IFFP which adds improvements needed to the culinary water system to handle water demands from this area. The IFFP also includes updated cost estimates adding the projects for the Spring Run/Talons Cove area and updating costs for future projects based on the rising costs of current construction projects. 
EMC Point of Contact: City Engineer, Vince Hogge vhogge@eaglemountian.gov. 

Wastewater Master Plan and Impact Fee Facilities Plan (IFFP):

-	Wastewater Master Plan and Impact Fee Facilities Plan (IFFP): Consideration of an update to the Wastewater Master Plan and the Wastewater IFFP. This update adds the Spring Run/Talons Cove area to the Master Plan and IFFP which adds improvements needed to the wastewater system to handle sewer flows from this area. The IFFP also includes updated cost estimates adding the projects for the Spring Run/Talons Cove area and updating costs for future projects based on the rising costs of current construction projects. 
EMC Point of Contact: City Engineer, Vince Hogge vhogge@eaglemountain.gov.

Amendments to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code: 

-	EMMC 9.10 and 17.47 - Archery Use Within the City: Consideration of an amendment to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapters 9.10 (Weapons) and 17.47 (Outdoor Shooting Range Overlay Zone) regarding archery use within the City. The proposed code amendment would add archery to the Outdoor Shooting Range Overlay Zone and establish standards for conducting archery activities safely within City boundaries.    
EMC Point of Contact: Assistant to the City Manager, Natalie Winterton nwinterton@eaglemountain.gov. 

-	EMMC 17.60.120 - Barbed Wire Fencing: Consideration of an amendment to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.60.120 (General Fencing/Screening Provisions). The proposed code amendment would allow barbed wire fencing in the RTI Overlay Zone and clarify that chain link fencing, where permitted, may not be topped with barbed wire.
EMC Point of Contact: Senior Planner, Robert Hobbs, rhobbs@eaglemountain.gov. 

-	EMMC 17.25.040 - Residential Standards Table: Consideration of an amendment to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.25.040 (Residential Standards Table) to recognize as legally nonconforming existing lots smaller than 4,500 square feet that are rezoned to the RC Zone. The amendment would also recognize existing building setbacks that are smaller than the minimum setbacks otherwise required in the RC Zone. 
EMC Point of Contact: Senior Planner, Robert Hobbs, rhobbs@eaglemountain.gov.  

-	EMMC 17.100.040 - Master Site Plans: Consideration of an amendment to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.100.040 (Master Site Plans). The proposed code amendment would clarify when a Master Site Plan or Standard Site Plan is required, establish the applicable review process, require a separate plat application for land proposed to be subdivided within a site plan, and allow approval of a subdivision plat before Master Site Plan approval. 
EMC Point of Contact: Senior Planner, Robert Hobbs, rhobbs@eaglemountain.gov.  


THE PUBLIC IS INVITED TO PARTICIPATE IN ALL CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS.

Materials for public hearing items may be viewed within three days of the meeting on the city website and at the Eagle Mountain City Recorder's Office, 1650 E Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, UT, during normal business hours, Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. If you need special accommodation to participate in the meeting, please call the City Recorder's Office at 801.789.6611.  Open portions of the meeting can be viewed at www.eaglemountain.gov. 

Certificate of Posting
The undersigned, duly appointed City Recorder, does hereby certify that the above public hearing notice was posted on this 25 day of September, 2026, on the Eagle Mountain City bulletin boards, the Eagle Mountain City website, www.eaglemountain.gov, and posted to the Utah State public notice website http://www.utah.gov/pmn/index.html.

Lacie A. Messerly, City Recorder

notices.agenda_text:
EAGLE MOUNTAIN
CITY COUNCIL MEETING

OCTOBER 6, 2026, 4:00 PM
EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
1650 E STAGECOACH RUN, EAGLE MOUNTAIN, UT 84005

4:00 PM WORK SESSION - CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS

1. DISCUSSION AND INFORMATION ITEMS
This is an opportunity to provide information to the City Council. These items are for information
only and do not require action by the City Council.
1.A. DISCUSSION - RV Parking Code Amendment
(anticipated time 20 minutes)
1.B. DISCUSSION - Overview of UFA/UFSA
(anticipated time 30 minutes)
1.C. DISCUSSION - Chaplain Services
(anticipated time 10 minutes)
1.D. PRESENTATION - Investment Portfolio Update
(anticipated time 15 minutes)

2. CITY MANAGER INFORMATION ITEMS
This is an opportunity for the City Manager to provide information to the City Council.

3. AGENDA REVIEW
The City Council will review items on the Consent Agenda and Policy Session Agenda.

4. ADJOURN TO A CLOSED SESSION
The City Council will adjourn into a Closed Session for the purpose of discussion of pending or
reasonably imminent litigation; the character, professional competence, or physical or mental health
of an individual; the purchase, lease, sale, or exchange of real property; a proposed development
agreement, project proposal, or financing proposal related to the development of land owned by
the state or a political subdivision; and/or the deployment of security personnel, devices, or
systems, pursuant to Section 52-4-205(1) of the Utah Code, Annotated.

7:00 PM POLICY SESSION - CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS

5. CALL TO ORDER
6. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
7. INFORMATION ITEMS/UPCOMING EVENTS
8. PUBLIC COMMENTS
Time has been set aside for the public to express their ideas, concerns, and comments.
(Please limit your comments to three minutes each.)

9. CITY COUNCIL/MAYOR ITEMS
Time has been set aside for the City Council and Mayor to make comments.
CONSENT AGENDA

10. BOND RELEASES
10.A. Firefly NPA 8 Phase A, Plat 9 - Into Warranty
10.B. Firefly NPA 8 Phase B, Plat 1 - Into Warranty
10.C. Harmony Phase A, Plat 14 - Into Warranty
10.D. Overland Village 2 Phase A, Plat 4 - Into Warranty
10.E. Overland Village 2 Phase A, Plat 5 - Into Warranty
11. MINUTES

11.A. September 15, 2026 Minutes - Regular City Council Meeting
11.B. September 24, 2026 Minutes - City Council Strategic Planning Session

12. RESOLUTIONS

12.A. RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Ranches Parkway
Improvement Interlocal Agreement between Eagle Mountain City and Utah County
12.B. RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah Approving a Purchase
Agreement with Smith's Food & Drug Centers, Inc
12.C. RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Purchase
Agreements with various residents to purchase Utah County Parcel No. 49:601:0079 and
No. 49:601:0080 following a Land Disposal application located in Pioneer Addition Phase II
12.D. RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving a Community Garden
Policy

SCHEDULED ITEMS

13. RESOLUTIONS

13.A. RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Authorizing the Land Disposal
Application to Proceed and Directing Staff to Begin the Notice and Public Hearing Process
for a Portion of Utah County Parcel No. 66:828:2978, Designated as 'Significant Real
Property' Pursuant to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code 3.30.060
BACKGROUND: (Presented by City Recorder Lacie A. Messerly) This item is a request to
dispose of a portion of Utah County Parcel #66:828:2978 designated as 'Significant Real
Property' in accordance with EMMC 3.30.060. The application, submitted by Eric Schenk
pertains to approximately 0.021 acre (~907.5 sq/ft) of property located at Silverlake, Plat
29.

13.B. RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Authorizing the Land Disposal
Application to Proceed and Directing Staff to Begin the Notice and Public Hearing Process
for a Portion of Utah County Parcel #46:491:0332, and Entire Parcels #46:536:0430 and
#46:865:0114, Designated as 'Significant Real Property' Pursuant to Eagle Mountain
Municipal Code 3.30.060

BACKGROUND: (Presented by City Recorder Lacie A. Messerly) This item is a request to
dispose of a portion of Utah County Parcel #46:491:0332, and Entire Parcels #46:536:0430
and #46:865:0114 designated as 'Significant Real Property' in accordance with EMMC
3.30.060. The application, submitted by Chelsea Lindsay and neighboring residents
pertains to approximately a total of 0.72 acres over three separate parcels located at
Meadow Ranch V, Plat 1, Meadow Ranch, Plat 3 and Meadow Ranch, Plat 4.

14. CORRIGAN FARMS REZONE

14.A. ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Rezoning
Certain Lands Known as Corrigan Farms

BACKGROUND: (Presented by Senior Planner, David Stroud) Corrigan Farms LLC is looking
to rezone parcel number 59:068:0006 to add the RTI overlay zone to the property to allow
it to potentially develop a data center project with a natural gas power plant.

14.B. ORDINANCE - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Corrigan Farms
Development Agreement

BACKGROUND: (Presented by City Attorney, Marcus Draper) The proposed agreement
accompanies the rezone of a 41-acre parcel owned by Corrigan Farms LLC to the RTI
Overlay Zone and establishes development and infrastructure requirements for the
anticipated data center project.
15. ORDINANCES/PUBLIC HEARINGS

15.A. ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Updating the
Culinary Water Impact Fee Facility Plan (IFFP)

BACKGROUND: (Presented by City Engineer, Vince Hogge ) Consideration of an update to
the Culinary Water IFFP. This update adds the Spring Run/Talons Cove area to the IFFP
which adds improvements needed to the culinary water system to handle water demand
from this area. The IFFP also includes updated cost estimates adding the projects for the
Spring Run/Talons Cove area and updating costs for future projects based on the rising
costs of current construction projects.

15.B. ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Updating the
Wastewater Master Plan and the Wastewater Impact Fee Facility Plan (IFFP)

BACKGROUND: (Presented by City Engineer, Vince Hogge ) Consideration of an update to
the Wastewater Master Plan and the Wastewater IFFP. This update adds the Spring
Run/Talons Cove area to the Master Plan and IFFP which adds improvements needed to
the wastewater system to handle sewer flows from this area. The IFFP also includes
updated cost estimates adding the projects for the Spring Run/Talons Cove area and
updating costs for future projects based on the rising costs of current construction
projects.

15.C. ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the
Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 9.10 and 17.47 Regarding Archery Use Within the
City

BACKGROUND: (Presented by Assistant to the City Manager, Natalie Winterton): The
proposed amendment would allow outdoor archery ranges within the existing Outdoor
Shooting Range Overlay Zone and indoor archery ranges as a special use, while
establishing standards intended to discourage archery in backyards or other unsafe
locations. Staff also reviewed USA Archery standards when developing the proposed
regulations.

15.D. ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the
Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.60.120 General Fencing/Screening Provisions

BACKGROUND: (Presented by Senior Planner, Robert Hobbs ) The proposed amendment
would allow barbed wire fencing in the RTI Overlay Zone and clarify that chain link fencing,
where permitted in industrial areas, shall not be topped with barbed wire as it would only
be allowed for the RTI Zone.

15.E. ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the
Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.25.040 Residential Standards Table

BACKGROUND: (Presented by Senior Planner, Robert Hobbs ) The proposed amendment
would acknowledge as legally conforming existing lots smaller than 4,500 square feet that
are rezoned to the RC Zone. The amendment would also recognize existing building
setbacks that are smaller than the minimum setbacks otherwise required in the RC Zone.

15.F. ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the
Eagle Mountain Municipal Code 17.100.040 Master Site Plans

BACKGROUND: (Presented by Senior Planner, Robert Hobbs ) The proposed amendment
would clarify when a Master Site Plan or Standard Site Plan is required, establish the
applicable review process, require a separate plat application for land proposed to be
subdivided within a site plan, and require approval of a Master Site Plan before approval of
a plat for land proposed to be subdivided within that Plan's area.

16. DISCUSSION ITEM ONLY/NO ACTION TAKEN

16.A. DISCUSSION - Speed Study Results
(anticipated time one hour)

17. LEGISLATIVE ITEMS

17.A. UPDATE - Legislative Priorities List

18. CITY COUNCIL/MAYOR'S BUSINESS AND LIAISON REPORTS

This time is set aside for the City Council's and Mayor's comments on City business, and for
Councilmembers to report on the boards they are assigned to as liaisons to the City Council.

19. COMMUNICATION ITEMS

19.A. Upcoming Agenda Items
19.B. Budget Report - August 2026

20. ADJOURNMENT

THE PUBLIC IS INVITED TO PARTICIPATE IN PUBLIC MEETINGS FOR ALL AGENDAS.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, Eagle Mountain City will make reasonable
accommodations for participation in all Public Meetings and Work Sessions. Please call the City
Recorder's Office at least 3 working days prior to the meeting at 801-789-6611. This meeting may be held
telephonically to allow a member of the public body to participate. This agenda is subject to change with
a minimum 24-hour notice.

CERTIFICATE OF POSTING

The undersigned, duly appointed City Recorder, does hereby certify that the above agenda notice was
posted on this 1 day of October, 2026, on the Eagle Mountain City bulletin boards, the Eagle Mountain
City website www.eaglemountain.gov, posted to the Utah State public notice
website http://www.utah.gov/pmn/index.html.

Lacie A. Messerly
City Recorder
